title: Implement CSSOM spec
impact: Maintainer-filed long-term idea (2021), 9 +1 reactions; Deno (lucacasonato) was interested in 2022 for CSSStyleSheet, needing only parse/serialize primitives. No recent demand in the index beyond #440/#556 (which ask for parse/serialize in JS, not CSSOM).
summary: Tracking idea to expose CSSOM / Typed OM as the JS API. The Rust foundations landed in 2022 (#140 public Parse/ToCss, #143 serde AST, #165 'Foundations for CSS OM': ordered DeclarationBlock get/set/remove with shorthand/longhand handling). Nothing CSSOM-shaped exists in the JS binding; the WIP PR #10 has been open and untouched since 2021. The JS API went the visitor route instead (transform({visitor}), StyleSheet visitor since 1.23.0).
repro: No repro: there is no JS behavior to pin; the Rust primitives are covered by the crate's own tests. JS parse/serialize workarounds are pinned in 440-repro.mjs and 556-repro.mjs.
evidence: Read issue + comments, PR #10 body, find-issues --refs 5 (#140, #143, #165), grep of src/declaration.rs and node/index.d.ts on master (dd8feeb).

fix.approach: Either a JS CSSOM layer over parse/serialize primitives (Deno's suggested design: pure parse_rule/serialize ops, state held in JS), or close as not planned in favor of the visitor API. Prerequisite either way: small JS parse/print primitives (see #440/#556).

openPRs.assessment: WIP from 2021 implementing CSSOM in the napi crate; stale, predates the visitor API and major AST changes; not reviewable as is. Could be closed.

notVerified: Whether Deno still wants this (Deno has not shipped CSSStyleSheet as far as the index shows); WPT CSSOM serialization conformance was not run.
